For the petitioner : Mr. Mahesh Tewari, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sardhu Mahto, A.P.P
-----
02/14.08.2024
The petitioner is apprehending her arrest for the offences punishable under Sections 323/307/406/409/420/520/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.

As per the allegation, the petitioner and her husband Vijay Paswan forcibly and mischievously got 13 cheques signed by the informant - Kashinath Rajwar and thereafter illegally withdrew Rs.17,51,900/- from the bank by encashing the said cheques in the financial year 2021-22, thereby embezzled the government money.
It is further submitted that the entire story made out in the written report is false and concocted.

In fact, the petitioner who happened to be ex- mukhiya of Kharkhari Panchayat, had withdrawn the aforesaid amount towards execution of public work by presenting the cheques bearing her and the informant's joint signatures, however, there was no illegality in the same.
It is also submitted that on 10.12.2022, a six-member enquiry committee was constituted by the Block Development Officer, Baghmara.
As per the report of the said committee, both the petitioner and the informant were responsible for withdrawing money without executing the work.
The said report was, however, prepared behind the back of the petitioner and hence, has no legal significance.
Nonetheless, no F.I.R to that effect has been lodged on behalf of the government alleging that the petitioner has embezzled the government money.
The petitioner, however, undertakes to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, she may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.P.P opposes the petitioner's prayer for anticipatory bail.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the materials available on record, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named,
